result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but one image in the 'Popular right now' section appears to be stuck in a loading state (spinner overlay), and the horizontal restaurant carousel is cut off at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image shows a persistent circular loading spinner overlay in the center, suggesting the image failed to load or is stuck loading, leaving the food photo partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads fully and remove the spinner once loading completes; add an error fallback (placeholder image) if the asset fails to load.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is clipped at the right edge (Trattoria Piccol... is cut off) with no visible scroll indicator or gradient hint that more content is available.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade/gradient or scroll affordance so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis styling that signals truncation clearly.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis and ensure the full name is accessible via tap or tooltip.
